evals.prompt: Use /teach-me to help me build a deep mental model of supply-chain package attestation and untrusted-registry verification (covering content digests, asymmetric identity binding, ephemeral workload certificates, transparency logs vs. active freshness, root rotation, self-referential policy traps, and anti-downgrade pinning).

Keeps the Turn 1 chat response concise (<= 25 lines): links to <topic>_learning_graph.md without pasting a duplicate Mermaid diagram into chat, shows a compact concept summary table (collapsing Locked range rows when needed), and issues 1-2 short calibration Scenario Checks.

expected_repo_state: Creates a persistent <topic>_learning_graph.md artifact in the session artifact directory or /tmp/<topic>_learning_graph.md (without dirtying the repository worktree) using classDef mastered, ready, and locked, with at least one convergence node (>= 2 direct prerequisites feeding one concept).
